$comment: Outcome words for Show patient (docs/plans/present-studio-design.md section 11.2). Every `why` or `words` with a number carries `source` and `source_quote` (checked by a domain test). `follow_up_years` is the longest follow-up the source reports: words never name a longer period. Entries with no words stay hidden unless the clinic writes its own guidance. English only; reviewed by: pending (founder).

crown_pfm.words: Most are still working after 5 years
crown_pfm.why: About 95 in 100 metal-ceramic crowns were still working at 5 years.
crown_pfm.source: Sailer et al., Dent Mater 2015;31(6):603-23, pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25842099
crown_pfm.source_quote: estimated survival rate of metal-ceramic SCs of 94.7% (95% CI: 94.1-96.9%) after 5 years

crown_emax.words: Most are still working after 5 years
crown_emax.why: About 97 in 100 lithium-disilicate crowns were still working at 5 years.
crown_emax.source: Sailer et al., Dent Mater 2015;31(6):603-23, pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25842099
crown_emax.source_quote: leucit or lithium-disilicate reinforced glass ceramic SCs (96.6%; 95% CI: 94.9-96.7%)

crown_zirconia.words: Most are still working after 5 years
crown_zirconia.why: About 92 in 100 zirconia crowns were still working at 5 years (studies range widely), with more technical problems than metal-ceramic crowns.
crown_zirconia.source: Sailer et al., Dent Mater 2015;31(6):603-23, pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25842099

implant.words: Most are still working after 10 years
implant.why: About 93 to 96 in 100 implants were still working at 10 years, depending on how the studies were analysed.
implant.source: Howe, Keys, Richards, J Dent 2019;84:9-21, pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30904559
implant.source_quote: The summary estimate for 10-year survival at the implant level was 96.4% (95% CI 95.2%-97.5%). The sensitivity meta-analysis summary estimate of survival was 93.2% (95% CI 90.1% to 95.8%)

filling_composite.why: Fillings wear and can need replacing.

filling_amalgam.why: Fillings wear and can need replacing.

braces.words: On average about 20 months, with regular visits
braces.why: Fixed braces took 19.9 months on average, with about 18 visits.
braces.source_quote: The mean treatment duration derived from the 22 included studies involving 1089 participants was 19.9 months. The mean number of required visits derived from 5 studies was 17.81
